product_freeze_sha256_policy: explicit UNBOUND placeholder; Codex binds the final product sha256 before any build
native_writer: separate Native author; this harness does not write Native/controller code

fixture_contract.duplicate_t7: valid normal metadata; canonicalizes duplicate pooled/raw selection
fixture_contract.duplicate_raw_t7: valid normal metadata; canonicalizes duplicate raw selection
fixture_contract.no_capacity_guard: no arbitrary selected_rows <= tokens + sequences rejection in the harness
fixture_contract.sha256_owner: control/generate_fixtures.py emits the t9 manifest sha256 before freeze/build

fields.name: exact fixture name
fields.status: ok for expected valid numeric or exact expected invalid variant

normalized.ordering: cases by manifest order; outputs by canonical index
normalized.empty_outputs: semantic-only; entry_count=0 is not a numeric pass
normalized.invalid: compare exact BackendError variant; never compare error strings as gold and never count unexpected/invalid as a pass
normalized.lifecycle: life-service/life-core reports are harness lifecycle evidence, not Native quality gold; core third-held submit must be exercised from an owned worker because the common two-slot pool blocks while both results are held
normalized.no_flattening: identity index/kind/shape and F32 words/bits must remain grouped per entry

comparison.numeric: exact F32 bits by default; no tolerance
comparison.identity: index, kind and shape must match before words
comparison.fatal: controller fails fatal; expected invalid is only a known manifest variant, not arbitrary BackendError
